issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but specifies its mechanism as post-0.1 item R025, and no open bead tracks it even though releases have moved past 0.1 (v0.2.x). Measured field evidence in the ADR (21 inverted edges in one workspace, 24 plus 7 cycles in another) makes this a recurring, currently undiagnosable authoring error. Add `verifies` as a third dependency kind across schema, CLI, and checkpoint serialization with round-trip preservation; diagnose inverted verification gates structurally (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) and report the diagnosis advisory-only from `doctor`; never reject such an edge at insert time and never infer the relationship from titles; surface the declaration to R023's `why` explanation. Cover the new edge kind with cycle-validation tests, checkpoint round-trip and unknown-field preservation, and concurrency tests per the repo's atomic-mutation doctrine, and document the field in the schema field guide.
